_comment: Lighthouse CI — SCAFFOLD ONLY, deliberately not wired into CI yet. specs/007 §3.3.
It runs against the built exampleSite demo and NEVER against production citizix:
AdSense and GTM put 100 permanently out of reach there, and the showcase's own rules
forbid live tracking credentials in exampleSite anyway (specs/009 §2, §3). Measure
citizix-shaped pages separately and report third-party effects independently from
numberOfRuns is 5 and the aggregation method is median-run, because the performance
score is variance-prone on shared CI runners and a single run turns a real gate into a
coin flip that people learn to re-run until green.
A perfect automated score is reported as an automated score. It is NOT WCAG
conformance and must never be described as such — specs/007 §3.3 and §4.
Not enabled yet because the theme is a foundation stub: there is no TOC, no copy
button and no real stylesheet, so any number recorded now measures the scaffold.
Turn it on at M4 alongside the visual baselines, and pin the Chrome and Lighthouse
versions in the workflow at the same time — an unpinned Lighthouse moves scores on
its own release schedule and the gate becomes noise.
